text: My 4 year old child can't speak, is afraid and struggles all the time. There is no coaxing or tricking (there is a cartoon screen but he doesn't watch it, he's very scared). He is ready to wrap himself up. It's our fault as a mother that our child has so many cavities that he needs to have 2-3 root canals and will probably need more fillings. The doctor was tired and sighing all the time. He recommended that we use sleeping pills at the hospital. I won't mention any other details. We walked out and paid 900 baht exactly, but I understood. This is the story!
